text: Mrs. Alice Shaw, the society siffleuse, gave a whistling recital before a fashionable audience; her warbling imitations of birds were encored repeatedly.
The famous siffleur Gialdini astonished the crowd, his artistic whistling soaring above the orchestra at the Grand Opera House.
A locomotive whistled in the distance as the night mail pulled out; the long whistle echoed across the harbour.
Young Ronalde, a whistler of uncommon skill, piped and warbled through a programme of popular airs to a delighted hall.
